proof_body:
by
  intro f y
  constructor
  · constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
      exact ⟨Real.sin x, Real.neg_one_le_sin x, Real.sin_le_one x, hx⟩
    · rintro ⟨t, h1, h2, ht⟩
      exact ⟨Real.arcsin t, by rw [Real.sin_arcsin h1 h2, ht]⟩
  · constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
      exact ⟨Real.cos x, Real.neg_one_le_cos x, Real.cos_le_one x, hx⟩
    · rintro ⟨t, h1, h2, ht⟩
      exact ⟨Real.arccos t, by rw [Real.cos_arccos h1 h2, ht]⟩
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (y : ℝ), ((∃ x : ℝ, f (Real.sin x) = y) ↔ ∃ t : ℝ, -1 ≤ t ∧ t ≤ 1 ∧ f t = y) ∧ ((∃ x : ℝ, f (Real.cos x) = y) ↔ ∃ t : ℝ, -1 ≤ t ∧ t ≤ 1 ∧ f t = y)
